entities.summary: Sultan bin Mohammed bin Saud Al Kabeer (b. 1954, Riyadh) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia. Known in the fields of saudi arabia, merchants & economists, asia.
